title: Settings

account.websiteLogin: Pages you open from the app sign you in to soberhelpline.com (ayudasobria.com in Spanish). To sign in there yourself, use “Forgot password?” on the site to set a password.

privacy.shareCheckInsDesc: Your assigned coach can see your check-ins and tracker entries. Turn this off anytime.
privacy.updateErrorBody: Your previous setting is still on. Please try again.

notifications.dailyNudgeBody: How are you doing today? Take a moment to check in.
dailyNudgeBodies: How are you doing today? Take a moment to check in.
A quick check-in keeps your streak — and your clarity — going.
90 seconds for yourself. How's your heart today?
You showed up yesterday. Show up for you again today.
Notice how you're feeling before the day takes over.
One small moment of honesty with yourself. Ready?
Your check-in is waiting whenever you are.
notifications.reminderDesc: Pick a time for a daily check-in reminder. Personal reminders are set separately.
notifications.weekReviewBody: You showed up this week. Open the app to see your check-ins, mood arc, and boundaries held.
notifications.practiceDesc: Get an occasional, clearly labeled practice call. Answer when ready and the AI starts a realistic conversation.
notifications.practicePrivacy: Notifications never show names, family details or conversation content. You can decline any call, no penalty.
notifications.practicePermissionBody: Allow notifications for Sober Helpline in your device settings, then try again. Practice calls stay off until then.
notifications.practiceSaveErrorBody: Your previous setting is still on. Please try again.
notifications.practiceLoadError: We couldn't load your practice-call settings. Nothing changed.
notifications.dailyErrorBody: Check notification permission in device Settings and try again. Reminders can't be guaranteed.
notifications.familyCallDesc: For Family Squares, our free Zoom call (Mondays, 7:00 PM Pacific). Spot saved: reminders 1 hour and 15 minutes before. Not saved: 30 minutes before. And a short note the next morning after a call you saved or joined.
notifications.familyCallErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.

membership.websiteSource: Your membership is through our website (soberhelpline.com or ayudasobria.com). Manage billing there.
membership.websiteAlsoSource: You also have a membership through our website (soberhelpline.com or ayudasobria.com), billed separately. Cancel it there if you don't need it.
membership.websiteMemberHint: Already a member on soberhelpline.com? Your membership follows your email. Sign in here with the same email.
membership.websiteMemberHintWithEmail: Already a member on soberhelpline.com? Your membership follows your email. Sign in here with the same email. You're signed in as {{email}}.
membership.restoreActiveBody: Your membership is active on this account.
membership.restoreNoneBody: We couldn't find any previous purchases for this Apple ID.
membership.restoreErrorBody: We couldn't restore your purchases. Please try again.
membership.attachedStoreNote: Your provider covers your access. If you also subscribed through the App Store or Google Play, cancel that here so you aren't charged twice.

review.title: Rate Sober Helpline
review.body: Your App Store rating helps another family find support.
review.unavailableBody: We couldn't open the App Store. Please try again later.

signOutErrorBody: We couldn't remove this device from private notifications. Check your connection and try again.

signOutOffline.title: No connection right now
signOutOffline.body: We can't reach the server to stop notifications on this device yet. You can still sign out: your sign-in details on this device are erased, and its notifications for this account turn off the next time you sign in with a connection.
signOutOffline.bodyWithQueue: We can't reach the server to stop notifications on this device yet. You can still sign out: your sign-in details on this device are erased, and {{checkins}} unsent check-in(s) and {{notes}} unsent journal note(s) are discarded. Its notifications for this account turn off the next time you sign in with a connection.

deleteAccount.confirmMessage: Your data will be permanently deleted within 30 days. This cannot be undone. If you have a soberhelpline.com account with this email, it is deleted too.
deleteAccount.subscriptionNote: Deleting your account does not cancel an App Store subscription. Cancel it first in your Apple ID subscriptions so you aren't charged again.
deleteAccount.subscriptionNoteWeb: A website membership billed through PayPal is cancelled automatically when you delete your account.
deleteAccount.errorMessage: We couldn't delete your account. Nothing was deleted and you are still signed in. Please try again.
deleteAccount.websiteErrorMessage: We couldn't remove your soberhelpline.com account or cancel its membership, so nothing was deleted. You are still signed in. Please try again in a few minutes.
deleteAccount.appErrorMessage: Your soberhelpline.com account was removed, but we couldn't finish deleting your app account. You are still signed in. Please try again.
deleteAccount.cleanupErrorMessage: Your account was deleted, but this device couldn't finish signing out. Close and reopen the app to clear it.

personalReminders.title: Personal reminders
personalReminders.body: A discreet reminder for your own next step. Optional, easy to pause, saved on this device.
personalReminders.cleanupTitle: Reminder cleanup could not be confirmed
personalReminders.cleanupBody: You are still signed in. Retry before signing out or deleting your account. You can turn off notifications in device Settings.
